CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Patriarchs Abraham? (1 mark)
   A. Use Bible Patriarchs Abraham to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Bible Patriarchs Abraham with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Patriarchs Abraham.
   D. Say Bible Patriarchs Abraham has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Samson kills a Lion? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Samson kills a Lion.
   B. Apply the teaching of Samson kills a Lion with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Samson kills a Lion has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Samson kills a Lion to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Zacchaeus the Tax Collector? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Zacchaeus the Tax Collector with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zacchaeus the Tax Collector.
   D. Use Zacchaeus the Tax Collector to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Honesty means: (1 mark)

   C. Hiding stolen items

7. Which response best shows understanding of My Family Family members? (1 mark)
   A. Use My Family Family members to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of My Family Family members with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My Family Family members.
   D. Say My Family Family members has no place in daily life.

8. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

9. Which response best shows understanding of Thoughts and feelings? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Thoughts and feelings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Thoughts and feelings to insult classmates of other faiths.

   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Thoughts and feelings.

11. Which response best shows understanding of The Annunciation? (1 mark)

   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Annunciation.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Balaam’s Donkey? (1 mark)
   A. Say Balaam’s Donkey has no place in daily life.

   C. Apply the teaching of Balaam’s Donkey with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Self-awareness? (1 mark)
   A. Use Self-awareness to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Self-awareness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Self-awareness has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Self-awareness.

14. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

15. Which response best shows understanding of Making choices? (1 mark)
   A. Use Making choices to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Making choices with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Making choices.
   D. Say Making choices has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
